title: Catastrophic effects of COVID-19 health expenditure shocks and multidimensional poverty in Ghana: what financing mechanisms mattered?
summary: More than half of Ghanaian households in the sample spent over 5% of their total expenditure on COVID-19-related health costs. Multidimensional poverty made these catastrophic payments worse, while insurance, remittances and government assistance softened the shock.
keyPoints: 52.2% of households spent more than 5% of total expenditure on COVID-19-related health costs.
Multidimensional poverty exacerbated catastrophic payments during the pandemic.
Insurance, remittances and government assistance mitigated the effects.
